name: Tags: pairings per generation and the tie rule
description: Table 1 of Riolo, Cohen & Axelrod 2001 and Table 7 of Edmonds & Hales 2003: the donation rate over 30 000 generations against pairings per agent, under each reading of who wins a tie. Measured (release, seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-25), coin flip / current agent / opponent: P = 1: 5.0 / 2.1 / 6.0%; P = 2: 44.0 / 2.0 / 50.3%; from P = 3 the rules agree (73.4–73.7, 76.8, 78.6–78.7, 79.1–79.2, 79.3%). The paper's jump between 2 and 3 pairings (4.3% to 73.6%) appears only when ties go to the current agent.
